overall_summary: Deduplicated analysis of 47 unique videos reveals a clear inflection point: 19–21 second 'What If You Fell Into [Extreme Cosmic Body]' experiential hooks heavily outperform generic factual trivia, capturing up to 1,030 views and top engagement rates (3.7% likes-per-view). In contrast, short 12–16 second psychology facts and repeated identical trivia (e.g., fake memories, octopus hearts) suffer severe audience fatigue, averaging under 70 views with near-zero engagement.

winning_patterns.pattern: First-Person Hazard What-If Framing ('What If You Fell Into...')
winning_patterns.evidence: Titles framed around falling into extreme cosmic bodies ('Liquid Diamond Planet': 1,029 views, 38 likes; 'Planet of Burning Ice': 972 views, 18 likes; 'Darkest Planet': 823 views, 15 likes) drove the channel's highest view counts and like ratios.
winning_patterns.action: Structure cosmic and extreme science videos around an immersive, immediate second-person sensory survival narrative rather than passive observational trivia.

winning_patterns.pattern: Extreme Exoplanet & Space Anomalies at 19-21s Duration
winning_patterns.evidence: Videos at 19–21s covering high-stakes cosmic phenomena (e.g., TrES-2b at 1,030 views, Venus day length at 981 views) drastically outperformed 12–16s clips which averaged fewer than 150 views.
winning_patterns.action: Standardize production at 20-21 seconds, allowing enough narrative pacing to build curiosity tension and deliver a substantive twist.

weak_patterns.evidence: Videos covering psychological memory and earworms ('Your Brain Can Create Fake Memories' with 5, 10, and 53 views across iterations; 'Real Reason Songs Get Stuck In Your Head' with 17 views) showed dead-end traction.
weak_patterns.action: Pause generic psychology/brain trivia shorts unless reframed with high-stakes micro-drama or visceral urgency.

weak_patterns.evidence: Re-uploading variants of 'Why Space Is Completely Silent' (34–220 views) and 'Octopuses Have THREE Hearts' resulted in diminishing returns and inconsistent algorithmic pickup.
weak_patterns.action: Enforce strict fresh-entity constraints; explore unvisited celestial or natural phenomena rather than cycling variations of previous scripts.
